name: Cordyceps
summary: Cordyceps (C. militaris/sinensis) is a caterpillar fungus used for energy and endurance in the functional-mushroom category. A 2025 meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (n=528 athletes) found improved endurance performance, ventilatory threshold, and VO2peak; a 2026 crossover (n=12) found faster post-exercise reaction time (PMID 42455764). The species on the label matters and is often unstated.
description: Canonical cordyceps research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until C. militaris vs C. sinensis species boundaries are explicit, small-sample caveats are documented, and wild-harvest vs cultivated product distinctions have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: aerobic capacity; adenosine signaling; exercise endurance
